summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: Package advertised as a React chatbot UI library ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases at install time, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob using an obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array with a per-character decoder. The bootstrap script `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with hex-prefixed identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and a key-rotated string map containing tokens such as `ldd`, `--version`, `/etc/os-release`, and `Alpine`, indicating environment fingerprinting. Neither the Bun runtime download nor the obfuscated payload has any relationship to a React UI component library. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling payload is an alternate-runtime-dropper pattern designed to evade Node-based scanners, and `npm install` of this version runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
